facts.text: Members of the Wheaton campus community promise before God to live according to its Community Covenant.

sources.title: Community Covenant - Wheaton College
sources.quote: we wholeheartedly promise before God to live “For Christ and His Kingdom.” Along with the privileges and blessings of belonging to Wheaton come sacred responsibilities
